# Every mutating /api/v1 route (RENT-BE-001 §8b). The integration suite fails
# when a route below commits without its audit event — exactly one, or one or
# more for a route marked "+" (runs and actions that issue documents and
# e-mails) — when a refused call leaves an event, or when a mutating route of
# internal/httpapi is missing from this list.
